english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for group agreement or a decision-making process built around reaching it.
Use 共識 when several people or parties share the same view or opinion.
Use this for a mutual agreement, including an agreement reached by resolving differences.

examples.english: We discussed it for a long time at the meeting and finally reached a consensus.
examples.traditional: 我哋開會傾咗好耐，終於有共識。
